subject: Re: Bellmont MSA - Security exhibit clarifications (pen-test window & evidence onboarding)
messages:
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@bellmonthealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bellmont Health Security <bellmont-security@bellmonthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Bellmont MSA redlines + security exhibit questions

Mina — attaching Bellmont's redlines to the MSA and the proposed order form. A few items we want to clarify on the security exhibit before we proceed: 

1) Penetration testing / third-party testing: we need explicit windows and notice periods (Bellmont requires a minimum 30-day notice and a 7-day blackout for production). Is Redwood able to commit to a defined notice and a maximum 30-day scheduling window?

2) SOC 2 evidence: currently the order form references "reasonable evidence" — Bellmont legal wants a short list of artifacts and a retention period (we typically ask vendors to retain relevant logs and SOC2 snapshots for at least 12 months).

3) Audit rights: we prefer a scoped, time-boxed inspection (sampling + review of SOC2 rather than full forensic access). Please confirm your proposed carve-outs for multi-tenant and staging access.

We'd like to get this wrapped before our procurement committee meeting on 12/15. Attaching the redlines (Bellmont_MSA_redlines.docx) and a short SOC/ops checklist.

Thanks,

Sarah Connors
Senior Counsel — Privacy & Security
Bellmont Health

Attachments: Bellmont_MSA_redlines.docx (docx) — redlined MSA, SOC checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Bellmont MSA redlines + security exhibit questions

Sarah — thanks for the redlines and the clear list. Quick acknowledgement and a few clarifying notes so we can coordinate internally: 

- Pen-test window: we generally support a timeboxed, scoped penetration test but want to propose a practical scheduling approach so we don't block production. I'll loop in legal and our security operations lead (cc'd).
- SOC2 artifacts & retention: we can provide the SOC2 report snapshot and an artifacts list (system diagrams, config snapshots, selective logs). We need to confirm the exact retention window you require for which artifacts.
- Audit rights: Redwood's preferred approach is a confined inspection option (sampled evidence + SOC2 report) with an option for privileged inspection under narrow conditions. We can propose language that limits impact to customer production and allows ephemeral access tokens rather than broad credentials.

Can your team confirm which artifacts are must-haves vs nice-to-have, and whether a 12-month retention is acceptable? If Bellmont needs a 30-day booking notice for pen tests I will ask Security to confirm whether scheduling within a 30-day window is feasible (we typically require a 2–4 week notice for operational readiness).

Proposed next steps: 
- Karthik will draft suggested exhibit language for a confined-inspection flow and pen-test notice.
- Laura will coordinate SOC2 snapshot delivery and a brief artifact index.
- I'll propose a short mutual action plan and timeline once we have those details.

I'll follow up with a proposed exhibit by EOD tomorrow.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Sales Ops (Security Contracts)
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bellmont MSA redlines + security exhibit questions

Mina / Laura — thanks for the ping. Draft position below (I will attach a suggested exhibit doc in the next email):

1) Penetration testing
- Position: Redwood will accept vendor-initiated pen tests under a scheduled window with at least 14 calendar days' notice from the customer and will cooperate on mutually agreeable dates. For customer-initiated external tests, Redwood requests a minimum 14 calendar day notice and we'll aim to complete scheduling within a 30-day window from request, subject to operational blackout dates.
- Rationale: 14 days allows our infra & on-call rotations to coordinate; committing to a strict 30-day max scheduling window is operationally feasible but we cannot guarantee exact dates earlier than the 14-day baseline. We can, however, agree to provide a scheduling window and escalation path for priority customers.

2) SOC2 artifacts & retention
- Position: Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report snapshot, a short artifact index (architecture diagrams, key configuration snapshots, and selected audit logs) on request. Redwood retains SOC2 reports and supporting archived snapshots for 12 months; logs retention varies by artifact — we can commit to retaining customer-specific audit artifacts required for the assessment for 12 months where feasible and permitted by our log retention policies.

3) Audit/inspection rights
- Position: Propose a two-tier inspection model in the security exhibit: 
  a) Tier 1 (standard): SOC2 snapshot + sampled evidence (log excerpts, config snapshots) provided via secure share. No production credentials required.
  b) Tier 2 (privileged inspection): limited privileged access for authorized auditors subject to a scoped statement of work, non-production tooling where possible, ephemeral credentials, a 3-party NDA, and advance scheduling (min 14 days). Privileged inspection will be time-boxed and limited to agreed artifacts only.

4) Suggested contract language highlights
- Limit forensic access to sampled, pre-agreed artifacts; require an SOW for any privileged inspection; include a clause for operational blackout windows; retain right to postpone for safety if the requested activity materially impacts production.

Next steps: I'll attach a redline of the security exhibit (Redwood_Suggested_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx) with the two-tier model and specific pen-test notice language. Laura — can you confirm we can produce the SOC2 snapshot + artifact index by EOD? Mina — I'll aim to get the redline to you in the next 3–4 hours so you can share with Bellmont before their procurement meeting.

Karthik Iyer
Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Suggested_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx (docx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bellmont MSA - Security exhibit clarifications (pen-test window & evidence onboarding)

Sarah — thanks for the patience. Quick summary / proposal from Redwood below based on our legal + security review (attached redline and SOC2 snapshot).

Summary of agreed positions:
- Pen-test scheduling: Redwood requests a 14-calendar-day notice for both vendor- and customer-initiated tests. We will use commercially reasonable efforts to schedule the test within 30 calendar days of receipt of notice and provide a single-point escalation if schedule priority is required. Operational blackout windows will be respected; Redwood will not permit testing during defined maintenance windows without prior consent.

- SOC2 & artifacts: Attached is a SOC2 snapshot (SOC2-snapshot-202610.pdf) and an artifact index. We commit to retaining SOC2 reports and related assessment artifacts for 12 months. Where Bellmont requests specific log retention beyond our standard retention band, we can evaluate and propose a commercial solution.

- Audit rights / inspection model: We propose a two-tier model (Tier 1: SOC2 + sampled evidence; Tier 2: privileged inspection by exception under SOW + ephemeral creds + 3rd-party NDA). The attached draft exhibit includes the exact wording (Redwood_Suggested_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx).

Requested confirmation from Bellmont:
1) Accept the 14-day notice baseline with a 30-day scheduling target (Bellmont had originally requested a strict 30-day notice — please confirm if you can accept 14 days with a 30-day scheduling target).
2) Confirm that 12-month SOC2/artifact retention is acceptable or indicate any specific artifacts that must be retained longer.

If Bellmont confirms both items we will incorporate the limited exhibit language into the MSA redline and circulate a consolidated redline + mutual action plan. We can also route the exhibit for DocuSign once both sides agree.

Proposed timeline: Confirm by 12/10 to allow consolidation and counter-redline by 12/11 (to meet Bellmont procurement on 12/15).

Thanks again — attaching: Redwood_Suggested_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx (proposed redline), SOC2-snapshot-202610.pdf (snapshot).

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Sales Ops (Security Contracts)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Suggested_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx (docx); SOC2-snapshot-202610.pdf (pdf)
